name: python-org/open-menu-link
description: Open python.org in Chrome and click the Jobs link in the site's top menu.
source_task: Open https://www.python.org/ and click the "Jobs" link in the site menu. This is an unattended test. Do not wait for a person. Decide yourself. Never buy, send, submit, save or delete anything. Leave the application window open when you are done.

steps.note: On python.org, 'Jobs' sits in the top network bar (Python, PSF, Docs, PyPI, Jobs, Community) and goes to /jobs/, whose title is 'Python Job Board | Python.org'.
Leaves Chrome open on the Jobs page. Nothing is closed, submitted or saved.
